question: Do the already secured al-Qalqashandi pages supply another concrete human writing operation beyond959's additive packets, without silently filling its alphabet/framing or reviving a failed modern completion?

source.work: Subh al-Asha, volumeIX, Cairo1916 printed edition
source.primary_method: Visually reread existing printed229–234. The exact adjacent grammatical example first located in the same text mirror was checked against printed235 of the same hash-identical original PDF. No OCR, source corpus or native material was read. The temporary full-volume download was only an access vehicle to235, not a text corpus intake.
source.dating: This is the1916 transmission of the historical work, which names Ibn al-Durayhim. No medieval manuscript of the treatise or Voynich adoption is established.

concrete_mechanisms.location: IX232, first major subsection and mnemonic
concrete_mechanisms.mechanism: Fixed reciprocal substitution of Arabic letters, called the Qumi convention. The passage expressly gives several reciprocal pairs and names as worked examples.
concrete_mechanisms.human_inverse_and_cost: Use the same learned pair table in either direction. This is a genuine simple hand operation, but the complete28-letter inventory is not itself a22-working-drawing carrier. A multigraph or contextual supplement would have to be a separately paid modern construction.
concrete_mechanisms.selection: Not a new architecture relative to ordinary fixed substitution. Do not infer that1228 rejects every Arabic text;1228's closure is specific to the full fixed bare Deot source and its declared screen.

concrete_mechanisms.mechanism: Reverse the letters within a word; separately exchange consecutive letter pairs, with the displayed multiword example crossing an original word boundary.
concrete_mechanisms.human_inverse_and_cost: The letter permutations are explicit involutions. Original word spacing, final odd letter and line conventions must be paid by a full reconstruction.
concrete_mechanisms.exact_existing_followup: HUMAN_QALQASHANDI_PAIR_TRANSPOSITION_REVIEW_20261006.json already corrected the false first-two-letters-only reading. HUMAN_FIXED_GAP_PAIR_SWAP_CONSTRUCTION_20261006.json supplied a modern complete935-based carrier, and HUMAN_FIXED_GAP_PAIR_SWAP_ROOT_REVIEW_20261006.json stopped its literal binding on the retained qokedy triple. No repaired pair swap is proposed.

concrete_mechanisms.location: IX233, paragraphs after the additive example
concrete_mechanisms.mechanism: Represent a letter by an agreed personal name or by the corresponding name in the28 lunar-mansion order; the text also mentions other ordered name/image lists.
concrete_mechanisms.human_inverse_and_cost: The reader needs the complete shared ordered list and recognition of each entry. This is alphabetic concealment, not a claim that the payload discusses people or astronomy. The page specifies the order and some entries, not a collated complete multiword cipher with all boundary/orthographic conventions and a22-unit realization.
concrete_mechanisms.duplicate_boundary: IDEA925 is related but not identical: its Trithemius cover word depends on a changing column/position, whereas this paragraph gives a fixed list.925 remains source-uncollated and later-dated. No fixed-name-list source addition is promoted into a complete new writer merely because this distinction exists.
concrete_mechanisms.conditional_cost_obligation: If each letter had one fixed complete name group, only the finite list's forms could occur as such groups. If several names are concatenated into a source word, the table instead becomes a longer letter-code table and must pay a unique parsing/framing convention. Neither reading is silently selected here;28 entries are not limited to the old at-most22 code-entry family.

concrete_mechanisms.location: IX233, lower prose immediately above the cipher-shape table
concrete_mechanisms.mechanism: Draw a distinct invented sign beneath each ordinary alphabet letter; explicitly separate words. The text lists several separator possibilities and says earlier writers represent a geminated letter twice, later writers once.
concrete_mechanisms.positive_scope: The primary explicitly recognizes alphabet conventions, word segmentation and gemination treatment as writing decisions. It does not make the later single spelling a unique phonemic or intended-meaning inverse.
concrete_mechanisms.boundary: This paragraph concerns the invented one-sign alphabet. Its word-separator convention cannot be silently transplanted into959 as proof of two-level additive packet/word framing. No modern shadda, extra sign or free context restoration was supplied.

ordinary_word_building_evidence.positive: The author explicitly distinguishes short ordinary words from longer words formed with additions, including comparison-k and addressee-k. This is concrete evidence that the historical discussion treats ordinary word construction as part of reading a cipher, not just a flat table of whole-word meanings.
ordinary_word_building_evidence.critical_correction: Do not use the following elaborate repeated-k examples as unqualified medieval word witnesses. On235 the boat example is bracketed; note1 says it was supplied from context and not located in language books. The cake form is also tied to note2, 'بياض في الأصل', a lacuna in the original. The printed modern edition therefore does not establish those exact forms as untouched historical examples.
ordinary_word_building_evidence.initial_statement_withdrawn: The earlier parent message pointing to وككعكك as a concrete primary whole-word illustration lacked this editorial qualification. That unqualified use is withdrawn. The explicit preceding discussion of productive additions remains separately visible.
ordinary_word_building_evidence.no_further_inference: The author's word-length, root-size and repetition assertions are not adopted as universal modern linguistic laws, native constraints or a new source-envelope population. No preferred source language or template is selected.

closest_existing_records.scope: Additive rule, minimal-value and triple consequences remain unchanged; this block adds neither values nor exceptions nor new packet framing.

Read full raw card and current ideas show. Fixed names and scheduled cover-word columns are related but distinct. Neither metadata status nor partial source wording proves an unexecuted complete candidate.

Fixed-source direct substitution/reversal remains closed; later wordbook, previous-source context and fixed-expansion studies have different contracts. No universal source-language rejection or automatic historical reconstruction follows.

decision: No new RAW writer card from this source block. The fixed-name-list operation is the clearest different historical family here, but a full agreed list plus paid parsing/group boundaries and22-drawing realization has not been established. Filling those arbitrarily would not yet add a source-motivated hand rule. Keep the positive source operations and the editorial correction, rather than calling all historical cryptography excluded or extending a known failed table.
